lessons.title: Introducing a Stainless Steel Railing Post

en: This is a stainless steel railing post for a glass balustrade system.
It supports the glass panels and can also connect to a handrail.
Glass clamps and handrail connectors are selected to match the system design.
End, middle, and corner posts are used at different positions in the layout.
Please share the layout drawing and glass details so we can confirm the configuration.
zh: 这是一款用于玻璃栏杆系统的不锈钢栏杆立柱。
它支撑玻璃面板，也可以连接扶手。
玻璃夹和扶手连接件需根据系统设计进行选配。
端柱、中间柱和转角柱用于布局中的不同位置。
请提供布局图和玻璃资料，以便我们确认配置。

lessons.knowledgeNote: 本课只介绍系统关系和确认流程。材质牌号、尺寸、承重、孔位及认证均须按实际项目资料确认。

question.en: What is this product used for?

en: It is a stainless steel railing post used to support a glass balustrade system.
zh: 这是一款用于支撑玻璃栏杆系统的不锈钢栏杆立柱。

question.en: How do the glass clamps work with the post?
question.zh: 玻璃夹如何与立柱配合？

en: The clamps are fitted at the required positions on the post to hold the glass panels.
We need the glass details and layout to confirm the clamp type and position.
zh: 玻璃夹安装在立柱所需位置，用于固定玻璃面板。
我们需要玻璃资料和布局图来确认夹具类型及位置。

question.en: Which post type should we use at a corner?
question.zh: 转角位置应使用哪种立柱？

en: A corner post is normally used where the railing changes direction.
Please send the layout so we can confirm the exact arrangement.
zh: 栏杆改变方向的位置通常使用转角柱。
请提供布局图，以便我们确认具体配置。

question.en: What information do you need to confirm the configuration?
question.zh: 确认配置需要哪些资料？

en: Please send the layout drawing, glass details, fixing surface, and handrail requirement.
Then we can check the post positions and matching accessories.
zh: 请提供布局图、玻璃资料、安装基面和扶手需求。
之后我们可以核对立柱位置和配套附件。

lessons.title: Explaining a Shower Hinge

en: A shower hinge connects a glass door to a wall or another glass panel.
It allows the door to open and close while supporting the selected door configuration.
The hinge type must match the glass arrangement and opening direction.
The required cut-outs and fixing method depend on the selected model.
Please send the door drawing and glass details before we recommend a hinge.
zh: 淋浴房铰链将玻璃门连接到墙体或另一块玻璃。
它使门能够开合，并适配所选的门体配置。
铰链类型必须匹配玻璃布局和开启方向。
所需开孔和固定方式取决于所选型号。
在推荐铰链前，请提供门体图纸和玻璃资料。

lessons.knowledgeNote: 本课不承诺承重、开启角度或适配玻璃厚度；这些参数必须根据实际型号资料确认。

question.en: What does this shower hinge connect?
question.zh: 这款淋浴房铰链连接什么？

en: It connects a glass door to a wall or to another glass panel, depending on the door layout.
zh: 根据门体布局，它可将玻璃门连接到墙体或另一块玻璃。

question.en: How do we choose the opening direction?

en: We first confirm the door layout and the required opening direction.
Then we match them to a suitable hinge model.
zh: 我们先确认门体布局和所需开启方向。
然后匹配合适的铰链型号。

question.en: Are the glass cut-outs the same for every hinge?
question.zh: 每款铰链的玻璃开孔都一样吗？

en: No. The cut-outs depend on the selected hinge model.
Please use the approved drawing before processing the glass.
zh: 不一样，开孔取决于所选铰链型号。
加工玻璃前请使用已确认的图纸。

question.en: What should I send you for hinge selection?
question.zh: 铰链选型需要我提供什么？

en: Please send the door drawing, glass details, opening direction, and mounting method.
We will check the suitable model and confirm its actual specifications.
zh: 请提供门体图纸、玻璃资料、开启方向和安装方式。
我们会核对合适型号并确认其实际规格。

lessons.title: Describing a Floor Spring

en: A floor spring is installed below the door and controls its movement.
It is commonly used with framed or frameless glass doors in a suitable door system.
Selection depends on the door size, door weight, opening direction, and usage conditions.
The matching top and bottom fittings must work with the door configuration.
Please confirm the actual model before discussing closing settings or hold-open functions.
zh: 地弹簧安装在门下方，用于控制门的运动。
它通常用于合适门系统中的有框或无框玻璃门。
选型取决于门尺寸、门重量、开启方向和使用条件。
配套的上下门夹必须与门体配置相匹配。
讨论闭门调节或定位功能前，请先确认实际型号。

lessons.knowledgeNote: 定位角度、承重范围和调速方式属于型号参数，不将示例条件当作实际产品参数。

question.en: Where is the floor spring installed?

en: It is installed below the door and works with the door fittings to control movement.
zh: 它安装在门下方，并与门夹配合控制门的运动。

question.en: Can you select a floor spring from the door width alone?
question.zh: 只看门宽可以选择地弹簧吗？

en: No. We also need the door weight, height, opening direction, and usage conditions.
Please share the complete door information.
zh: 不可以，我们还需要门重、门高、开启方向和使用条件。
请提供完整的门体信息。

question.en: Which fittings are used with the floor spring?
question.zh: 地弹簧与哪些配件配合使用？

en: It normally works with matching top and bottom fittings in the door system.
The exact fittings depend on the door configuration.
zh: 它通常与门系统中配套的上下门夹一起使用。
具体配件取决于门体配置。

question.en: Does this model have a hold-open function?
question.zh: 这个型号有定位功能吗？

en: That function is model-specific, so I need to check the exact item code first.
Could you confirm the model or send the required door conditions?
zh: 该功能取决于具体型号，因此我需要先核对准确货号。
您能确认型号或提供所需门体条件吗？

lessons.title: Introducing a Glass Sliding Door System

en: A glass sliding door system uses a track and rollers to guide the door panel.
The system may also include stops, guides, handles, and a soft-close unit.
The track length and fitting arrangement must match the opening and available space.
Glass details and the supporting structure are important for product selection.
Please send the opening dimensions and installation drawing so we can check the complete set.
zh: 玻璃滑门系统使用轨道和滑轮引导门扇移动。
系统还可能包括限位器、导向件、拉手和缓冲器。
轨道长度和配件布置必须匹配洞口及可用空间。
玻璃资料和支撑结构对产品选型很重要。
请提供洞口尺寸和安装图，以便我们核对整套配置。

lessons.knowledgeNote: “可能包括”表示可选配置；缓冲、承重、轨道长度和玻璃要求必须按具体系统资料确认。

question.en: What are the main parts of this sliding door system?
question.zh: 这套滑门系统的主要部件有哪些？

en: The main parts are the track and rollers.
The complete set may also include stops, guides, handles, and an optional soft-close unit.
zh: 主要部件是轨道和滑轮。
整套配置还可能包括限位器、导向件、拉手和可选缓冲器。

question.en: How do you confirm the required track length?
question.zh: 如何确认所需轨道长度？

en: We check the opening dimensions, door travel, and available installation space.
Please send the drawing so we can confirm the length.
zh: 我们会核对洞口尺寸、门扇行程和可用安装空间。
请提供图纸，以便确认长度。

question.en: What details do you need about the glass?

en: We need the panel dimensions, glass type, and the relevant hole or edge details.
We also need to understand the supporting structure.
zh: 我们需要门扇尺寸、玻璃类型以及相关孔位或边部资料。
我们还需要了解支撑结构。

question.en: Is the soft-close unit included in the standard set?
question.zh: 标准套装包含缓冲器吗？

en: It depends on the selected system and quotation scope.
Please confirm that you need soft close, and I will check the matching set.
zh: 这取决于所选系统和报价范围。
请确认您需要缓冲功能，我会核对配套配置。
